spans.s:
हहल हहल, अम्, n. (= हाहल, see हाल-
हल), a sort of deadly poison.

हाहल, अम्, n. (fr. the above with elision of ल
or ला), deadly poison.
हाहाल, अम्, n. the above poison.

हहा हहा, आस्, m. a kind of Gandharva,
q. v.; [cf. 1. हाहा, हुहू.]

हाहा 2. हा-हा, ind. (an interjection of
surprise or grief or pain, equivalent to) ah, ah! alas,
alas!
—हाहा-कार, अस्, m. ‘making the exclamation
हाहा,’ a general or great lamentation, or wailing;
sound of grief or pity; the noise or uproar of battle.
—हाहा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made to resound with
the uproar of battle.
—हाहा-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्,
lamented, bewailed.
—हाहा-रव, अस्, m. the cry
or noise हाहा.

हाहस् हाहस्, आस्, m. a Gandharva. (See
p. 281, col. 3.)
